answer: Vouch deposits scale quadratically along a sponsor lineage: the k-th clone a branch sponsors must lock k^2 * 10 credits per epoch, burned on lapse, so n clones cost 10 * sum(k^2), about 418 million credits per epoch at n=500, not n flat fees. Weight only flows over links that cross a ridge between disjoint sponsor genealogies, and every link erodes like karst unless its holder renews a live attestation thread each epoch, so a farm cannot buy standing once and coast. An honest newcomer locks one k=1 deposit of 10 credits and renews a single thread.
